blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Jessica Laurance may have finished last in the women’s 100-meter final at the Asian Games athletics on Friday, but the Filipino sprinter remained proud of making the championship race in her debut. Laurance clocked 11.58 seconds at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium, finishing eighth in the eight-woman final. China’s Yujie Chen won gold in a Games-record 11.06 seconds while Shanti Pereira of Singapore came in second. “I am proud that I even made the final,” Laurance said in a report released by POC Media Pool. “I was hoping for […]...
